text:
Sophie: Heads-up — NimbusWorks ran a marketplace promo that applied credits then billing reversed them after an eligibility check. Vendor invoice for reimbursement arrived after reversal. Need decision for Nov close: accrue vendor payable or treat as revenue deferral? Total reimbursable = $38,250.

Miguel: Are these credits customer-facing discounts or third-party reimbursements that revert to us?

Sophie: They are third-party reimbursements. Credits applied 2024-11-14, reversal executed 2024-11-18, vendor invoice dated 2024-11-21. Affected: 11 invoices. Quick split: acct-N1 $16,800 (annual prepaid, 10 months left), acct-N2 $9,450 (usage/overage recognized), acct-N3 $12,000 (quarterly prepaid, 2 months left). Total = $38,250.

Harper: RevRec policy summary: usage/overage amounts that have been recognized should be reversed immediately. Prepaid amounts should be converted to revenue deferral and amortized over the remaining contract term. Since vendor invoice exists and payment ETA is within 60 days, we can record a vendor accrual to avoid timing mismatch on the P&L. Because total > $25k, FP&A and Finance Lead review required.

Sophie: Vendor PO NW-4477. Vendor confirmation says payment ETA 2024-12-06. I'll attach the invoice and vendor confirmation to Confluence.

Miguel: Draft JE proposals for review (please confirm GL codes):
```
Dr Revenue Deferral (GL 2130) 38,250
  Cr Vendor Accrual / Payable (GL 2230) 38,250

Immediate reversal for usage-recognized portion (acct-N2 = 9,450):
Dr Revenue (GL 4030) 9,450
  Cr Revenue Deferral (GL 2130) 9,450
```
Notes: amortize prepaid portion ($28,800) across remaining months by account (acct-N1 10 months, acct-N3 2 months). Do NOT backdate amortization to earlier periods; start in the next open period. Tag memo "NimbusWorks promo reversal - Nov24" and attach per-invoice mapping.

Harper: One nuance — marketplace credits touched some customers via reseller flows. We need to include the reseller mapping in the supporting schedule. Also check whether any invoices were in non-USD (none in this case).

acct-bot: Reminder — month close lock 2024-11-30 23:59 PST. Post adjustments by 2024-11-29 EOD for review.

Miguel: I'll prepare the JE, per-account amort schedules (CSV), and a concise memo. Routing plan: send to finance-leads@redwood.com and cc revrec@redwood.com and accounting@redwood.com for sign-off.

revrec-bot: Auto-alert triggered — amount >$25k. Please include vendor invoice, PO NW-4477, per-invoice mapping, reseller flow mapping, and amortization schedule. Approval required from Finance Lead before posting.

Sophie: Thanks — uploading docs to Confluence now and will paste the link when done. :thumbsup:
